rust.name: src/host.rs:72:5: replace sha256 -> Option<String> with None
rust.why: Returning None for a readable file makes TLC miss a valid cached jar and prevents a matching digest from honoring a stand-in’s no-fault record.

rust.name: src/model.rs:461:32: replace || with && in check
rust.why: A test that checks the broken or timed-out verdict can still pass when the report drops the corresponding TLC output.

rust.name: src/tlc.rs:52:24: replace match guard got.success() with true in install
rust.why: A failed curl can leave a readable partial download, and this guard determines whether the fault reports the transfer failure or a checksum mismatch.

rust.name: src/tlc.rs:138:28: replace > with == in run
rust.why: The polling loop can step past the deadline without ever hitting equality, while a Java process that exits promptly exercises neither condition.

rust.name: src/tlc.rs:151:66: replace / with * in run
rust.why: The reported elapsed time becomes 10,000 times too large after rounding, which assertions on the verdict and state counts can miss.
